note: Farming (docs/30 section 8; #194). `soil`: `wetDays` how many game days watered soil stays wet (a dry crop pauses and never dies), `fillCost` the waterskin's fill a watering takes, `seconds` the timed actions; `crops`: per crop the days of each growing stage (`stages`: stage 0 to 1, stage 1 to ready), what a harvest gives (`harvest`, a count range) and the seeds back (`seeds`), and its seed item. Growth is derived from the planted hour and the wet hours, never stepped (src/farming.js). `grain`: a crop a scythe takes a row at a swing (src/farming.js `scytheSwing`).
